summary: The PR addresses the issue of custom empty labels being overridden in ModelAdmin with radio_fields. The fix appears correct and the new tests cover the expected behavior.

issues.description: The addition of a new model and test case in `tests/modeladmin/tests.py` seems unnecessary as a separate test file `tests/modeladmin/test_empty_label.py` was already created to cover the specific issue.
The print statement at the end of `tests/modeladmin/test_empty_label.py` is not needed and should be removed.
